findings.current: “After the Great Faction War, I hated the Demonic Path more than anyone. If they were traitors the Central Plains could never forgive, then they were enemies who had to die.”
findings.defect: The draft makes the Demonic Path the traitors whom the Central Plains could not forgive. The omitted subject of 변절자 is Baeksang himself, while 놈들 refers to the Demonic Path.
findings.rationale: The preceding explicit subject 나는 carries into the conditional description, and the following 놈들 separately identifies the Demonic Path as Baeksang’s enemies.
findings.replacement: “After the Great Faction War, I hated the Demonic Path more than anyone. If I was a turncoat the Central Plains could never forgive, then they were enemies who had to die.”
findings.source: “정마대전 이후, 나는 누구보다 마도(魔道)를 증오했다. 중원이 용서할 수 없는 변절자라면, 놈들은 반드시 죽여야 할 적이었지.”

findings.current: The flames that surged upward in a radius of dozens of yards consumed the wind and reduced countless fragments of debris, shot through the air like hidden weapons by the shock wave, to ash.
findings.defect: The draft silently converts 수십 여장 to “dozens of yards.” A jang is substantially longer than a yard, so this reduces the stated radius by roughly two-thirds and is inconsistent with the retained jang measurements elsewhere.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly measures the radius in jang and describes the flames as coiling through that area.
findings.replacement: The flames surged upward, coiling across a radius of dozens of jang as they consumed the wind and reduced to ash the countless fragments of debris hurled like hidden weapons by the shock wave.
findings.source: 반경 수십 여장을 휘감으며 솟구친 불길이 바람을 살라 먹고, 충격파에 의해 암기(暗器)처럼 쏘아진 무수한 잔해의 파편들을 잿가루로 만들었다.

findings.current: It was filled with an energy warmer than sunlight and as clear as water.
findings.defect: The draft renders the Murim term 기운 generically as “energy,” losing the required distinction between qi and modern Hunter-system mana.
findings.rationale: The light carries the sacred stone and guardian spirit’s supernatural Murim qi; the terminology rules require 기운 in this context to be rendered as “qi.”
findings.replacement: It was a light imbued with qi warmer than sunlight and as clear as water.
findings.source: 햇살보다 따스하고, 물처럼 맑은 기운을 품은 빛.

findings.current: The first time a Quest description had been this short. The first time a Quest whose restrictions usually contained my three-letter name had not been limited to anyone at all.
findings.defect: “Three-letter name” is factually false for Jin Taekyung in English and mistranslates 글자, which refers to the three written characters of his Korean name.
findings.rationale: 세 글자 describes the three characters composing his Korean name, not three alphabetic letters.
findings.replacement: The first time a Quest description had been this short. The first time the restriction field—which usually contained the three characters of my name—had not limited the Quest to anyone at all.
findings.source: 퀘스트 설명이 이렇게 짧았던 것도. 대부분 내 이름 세 글자가 적혀 있던 퀘스트 제한이 그 누구에게도 국한되지 않은 것도.

findings.defect: The game-generated identification window is formatted as unframed bold prose rather than an actual System panel.
findings.rationale: The bracketed level-and-name display is an actual game UI window and must use the prescribed System blockquote format.

summary: The draft contains one subject reversal, a significant unit-of-measure error, inconsistent Murim terminology, one misleading name-length calque, and a System-panel formatting violation.
